lines: This plan covers 2 days, starting Wednesday 2026-08-19.

dishes.name: Yoghurt fruit bowls
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, strawberries, blueberries and oats
dishes.method: Spoon the yoghurt into four bowls, top with the fruit and oats, then drizzle with honey.
dishes.why: A quick protein-led breakfast that needs no cooking and uses in-season summer fruit.

dishes.name: Chicken salad wraps
dishes.title: Roast chicken, lettuce, cucumber, tomato and wholemeal wraps
dishes.method: Reheat a portion of chicken and slice it with the salad vegetables, then fill the wraps and spread with mustard.
dishes.why: This turns one batch of chicken into a fresh lunch with very little weekday effort.

dishes.name: Chicken wraps for Nina
dishes.title: Roast chicken, lettuce, cucumber, tomato and wholemeal wraps
dishes.method: Reheat Nina's chicken box, then fill the wraps with the salad and mustard.
dishes.why: Nina gets her own lunch dish as required, built from the same cooking session but portioned separately.

dishes.name: Chicken rice bowls
dishes.title: Roast chicken, courgette, peppers and rice
dishes.method: Reheat a portion of chicken and serve it over the cooked rice and vegetables, finishing with lemon and parsley.
dishes.why: A straightforward dinner that uses the batch rice and roast vegetables while keeping the plate balanced.

dishes.name: Berry oat pots
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, raspberries, plums and oats
dishes.method: Divide the yoghurt between four bowls, add the fruit and oats, and scatter over the seeds.
dishes.why: Another no-cook breakfast that keeps protein at the centre and stays in season.

dishes.name: Tuna pasta salad
dishes.title: Tuna, wholewheat pasta, sweetcorn, cherry tomatoes and spinach
dishes.method: Reheat the pasta base if needed, then toss it with tuna, tomatoes and spinach, and finish with lemon.
dishes.why: It makes a full lunch from one batch and suits a work-from-home day with almost no extra effort.

dishes.name: Salmon and greens
dishes.title: Salmon fillets, new potatoes, green beans and dill yoghurt
dishes.method: Reheat the salmon portions, warm the potatoes and beans, and stir the yoghurt with dill and lemon for the sauce.
dishes.why: A second dinner from the week’s cooking that stays light, fast and protein-centred.

dishes.name: Tomato toast eggs
dishes.title: Eggs, tomatoes and wholemeal toast
dishes.method: Scramble the eggs with the tomatoes, toast the bread and butter it, then serve everything hot.
dishes.why: A simple cooked breakfast with a proper protein anchor for the first day.

dishes.name: Courgette frittata
dishes.title: Eggs, courgette, onions and feta
dishes.method: Cook the courgette and onion in a pan, add the eggs and feta, then finish the frittata under a lid or in the oven until set.
dishes.why: It uses summer vegetables well and gives a proper protein-led dinner without needing a second session.

dishes.name: Omelette breakfast
dishes.title: Eggs, spinach and mushrooms on toast
dishes.method: Cook the mushrooms and spinach, fold in the eggs, and serve with buttered toast.
dishes.why: A second cooked breakfast keeps the week varied while still being quick and protein-led.

dishes.name: Falafel lunch boxes
dishes.title: Falafel, couscous, cucumber, tomatoes and yoghurt
dishes.method: Reheat the falafel and couscous, then add the fresh vegetables and yoghurt.
dishes.why: It gives a meat-free lunch that still has a clear protein anchor and stays easy on a working day.

dishes.name: Chickpea salad dinner
dishes.title: Chickpeas, courgettes, peppers and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the chickpea and vegetable base, then add the salad, feta and lemon just before serving.
dishes.why: A quick second-day dinner from the same session that keeps vegetables high and cooking low.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs
preparations.method: Toss the chicken with oil, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper, then roast until golden and cooked through. Cool slightly and portion into four named boxes for the week.

preparations.title: Courgette pepper rice
preparations.method: Cook the rice, then fry the onion, courgettes and peppers in oil with salt and fold the rice through. Cool and box into four portions.

preparations.title: Tuna pasta salad base
preparations.method: Boil the pasta, drain and cool it, then mix with tuna, sweetcorn, spring onions, oil and salt. Box into four portions for tomorrow's lunch.

preparations.title: Salmon tray with potatoes
preparations.method: Roast the potatoes first, add the salmon and green beans partway through, then finish with dill and salt. Box the cooked salmon and vegetables into four portions for the next day's dinner.

preparations.title: Falafel and couscous boxes
preparations.method: Shape and bake the falafel, make the couscous, then cool both and portion with the vegetables into four boxes for lunch.

preparations.title: Chickpea vegetable tray
preparations.method: Roast the chickpeas and vegetables with oil, ras el hanout and salt until browned, then cool and box for dinner.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the oven and roast the chicken thighs. While they cook, chop the courgettes, peppers and onion for the rice, and put the rice on. In the same stretch, boil the pasta, drain it, and mix the tuna pasta salad base. Use the oven space after the chicken for the salmon tray with potatoes and green beans. As each batch is done, cool it briefly and weigh it straight into the named boxes.
Shape and bake the falafel while the couscous soaks. Roast the chickpea and vegetable tray in the same oven after or alongside it, then cool both and box them for the next meal.
